quote: Silence doesn't mean I missed it. Quite the opposite.
I don't confuse being polite with being available.
A group chat is a hostage situation with emojis.
The most dangerous phrase in any conversation is 'one more thing'.
A quiet witness often remembers what the loudest speaker forgets.
My final form is silence, sarcasm, and absolutely no obligations.
I joined the call on mute and considered it personal growth.
I observe the chaos without applying for membership.
I'd rather get a clean goodbye than a dirty explanation.
My idea of networking is unplugging the router.
My tolerance has aged like milk left in a parked car.
The less I explain myself, the quieter life becomes.
My social skills are fine. My willingness to use them is questionable.
